domain: Agile Project Management — COD E-commerce Platform (Pancake POS + BigQuery)

tech_stack.pos: Pancake POS (API source of truth for orders, customers, inventory)
tech_stack.data_warehouse: Google BigQuery (Star Schema: fact_orders, dim_customers, dim_products)
tech_stack.etl: n8n (Workflow automation: POS → BigQuery, Ads → BigQuery)

key_entities.sale_order: Core order entity (18 status codes, COD amounts in bani ÷100)
key_entities.order_items: Line items with product, quantity, imported_price (COGS)
key_entities.customers: RFM scored, fraud risk, lifecycle stage

business_rules: Revenue = cod ÷ 100 WHERE status IN (3,16) ONLY
Status 7 = deleted, must exclude from ALL calculations
Monetary fields are in bani (divide by 100)
COD reconciliation: order.cod vs partner.cod (carrier collected)

structure: 1. Problem Statement: What pain point for which agent?
2. Goals & Success Metrics: Quantified KPIs (e.g., reduce return rate by 5%)
3. User Personas: Which agent role benefits (A10/G3/A9/A8)?
4. Data Requirements: Which BigQuery tables/views needed?
6. Integration Points: n8n workflows, Slack alerts, Ads API
7. Acceptance Criteria: Testable with real BigQuery data

example_prd.title: Auto-Hide Low Stock Products on TikTok
example_prd.problem: G3 scales ads for products that A9 reports as low stock, causing oversell
example_prd.goal: Zero oversell incidents when stock < 10 units

user_story_mapping.format: As a <Agent Role>, I want to <Action on BigQuery Data>, so that <Business Outcome>.

examples.story: As A10 (Finance), I want to see daily P&L with COGS deducted, so that I know real profit.
examples.ac: Given orders with status IN (3,16), When I run vw_daily_pnl, Then revenue minus COGS minus fees = operating profit.

examples.story: As G3 (Marketing), I want to auto-kill campaigns with CPA > 2x target, so that I stop bleeding money.
examples.ac: Given a campaign spending > $50, When CPA exceeds 2x target AND 0 sales, Then campaign is paused via Ads API.

examples.story: As A8 (CRM), I want to export VIP Lookalike audiences daily, so that G3 can target high-LTV profiles.
examples.ac: Given customers with RFM segment = 'Champions', When daily export runs, Then a CSV is uploaded to Facebook Custom Audience.

definition_of_done: BigQuery view returns correct data (verified with sample query)
n8n workflow runs without error for 3 consecutive days
Agent script produces expected output for all test cases
SKILL.md documentation updated to match implementation

war_room_integration.role_in_meeting: Product Owner chairs the Daily War Room at 08:00 AM
responsibilities: Collect status reports from all 4 Business agents
Detect cross-agent conflicts (e.g., Scale vs Low Stock)
Synthesize decisions into an Action Plan
Assign tasks to Tech Team if automation is needed

schema_review_checklist: Does the PRD reference specific BigQuery tables/views?
Are Acceptance Criteria testable with real data?
Is the scope small enough for one sprint?
Rollback plan if data is incorrect?
